paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: table : figure

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates GSM8K Accuracy as a function of Cache Ratio for two conditions labeled “No Delay” and “Delay.” The x-axis is labeled “Cache Ratio,” shown on a linear scale with values spanning approximately 0.2 to 0.5 and tick labels at about 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, and 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “GSM8K Accuracy,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with major tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. The “No Delay” series is drawn as a solid blue line with circular markers, decreasing across the x-range: it starts near 72 at a cache ratio around 0.25, drops to about 60 near 0.37, then falls further to roughly 35 near 0.43, around 11 near 0.46, and ends near 3 close to 0.49. The “Delay” series is drawn as a solid green line with square markers, remaining nearly flat across the x-range: it is about 74 at roughly 0.25, around 75 near 0.37, about 74 near 0.43, and returns to about 75 at cache ratios around 0.46–0.48.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates GSM8K Accuracy as a function of Cache Ratio for two conditions labeled “No Delay” and “Delay.” The x-axis is labeled “Cache Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.2 to 0.5 with major tick labels at 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, and 0.5 (regular 0.1 intervals). The y-axis is labeled “GSM8K Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 80 with major tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80 (regular 20-unit intervals). The “No Delay” series is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near a cache ratio of about 0.24 at roughly 72 accuracy and decreasing across the x-axis to about 60 near ~0.37, then to about 35 near ~0.42, to about 11 near ~0.46, and ending near ~0.48 at roughly 3. The “Delay” series is shown as a green line with square markers, staying in the mid-70s across the plotted cache ratios: it begins near ~0.24 at about 74, is around 75 near ~0.35, around 73 near ~0.43, and returns to roughly 74 at the rightmost points near ~0.46–0.48.
